recommended_primary: NSAID‑induced acute‑on‑chronic kidney injury (AKI on CKD‑4)
review_summary: The differential captures the major organ‑system problems and correctly prioritizes NSAID‑induced AKI, but probabilities needed recalibration and several actionable domains (cardiorenal syndrome, explicit volume overload, electrolyte abnormalities, vaccination/infectious screening, frailty) were omitted. Overall the reasoning is solid but incomplete.
